english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when get means obtain or receive something.
Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when you mean being able to get or access the data.
Use this for the everyday sense of successfully getting or obtaining something, especially a concrete or desired thing.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for successfully getting or securing something.
